headerDisplay: ⚠️ **Requires the [homebridge-hilo](https://github.com/johannrichard/homebridge-hilo) plugin.** This plugin reuses homebridge-hilo's refresh token and reads it automatically from your Homebridge config whenever homebridge-hilo is configured — install and set up that plugin first. The refresh token field below is only a fallback.

name.title: Name
name.description: Platform name shown in the Homebridge logs.

refreshToken.title: Hilo Refresh Token (optional fallback)
refreshToken.description: Leave blank when homebridge-hilo is configured — its current refresh token is read automatically from your Homebridge config. Only used as a fallback, e.g. when homebridge-hilo is not in this config.

locationId.title: Location ID (optional)
locationId.description: Your Hilo location URN. Found in homebridge-hilo logs: 'Subscribed to updates for location urn:hilo:crm:...'  Leave blank to auto-discover.
